result.instructions: Tools for Metricool, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which posts are scheduled for next week, and on which networks?"; "Draft a post for Instagram on Friday at 10:00 and keep it as a draft."; "What are the best times to publish on Instagram this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Metricool data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run metricool_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run metricool_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run metricool_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. metricool_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: metricool_list_brands
tools.title: List brands
tools.description: List the brands (blogs) of the Metricool account, with their blogId, name and connected networks. Use it first to find a blogId. Swagger: GET /admin/simpleProfiles.

tools.name: metricool_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Return the account's Metricool subscription: plan, status, brand and post limits, and usage counts. Swagger: GET /profile/subscription.

tools.name: metricool_list_calendar_posts
tools.title: List scheduled posts in a period
tools.description: List the brand's scheduled and published posts in a date range (calendar report). Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/posts.

annotations.title: List scheduled posts in a period

tools.name: metricool_get_scheduled_post
tools.title: Get a scheduled post
tools.description: Return one scheduled post by id: text, publication date, networks and status. Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/posts/{id}.

tools.name: metricool_create_scheduled_post
tools.title: Create a scheduled post
tools.description: Create a post for the brand. DRAFT by default (draft=true saves it without publishing). Set draft=false only when the user asks to schedule it: the post then publishes at publicationDate. Swagger: POST /v2/scheduler/posts.

dateTime.description: Local date and time, for example 2026-12-01T10:00:00.

networks.description: Networks to post to, for example facebook or instagram (one entry per network).

draft.description: true (default) saves a draft; false schedules the post.

firstCommentText.description: Optional first comment under the post.

media.description: Optional public image or video URLs.

tools.name: metricool_delete_scheduled_post
tools.title: Delete a scheduled post
tools.description: Delete one scheduled post by id. The post is removed from the planner and is not published. Swagger: DELETE /v2/scheduler/posts/{id}.

tools.name: metricool_list_library_posts
tools.title: List library posts
tools.description: List the brand's library posts (drafts and ideas), optionally filtered by brand tag ids. Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/library/posts.

tags.description: Brand tag ids; keeps only items that have any of them.

tools.name: metricool_get_library_post
tools.title: Get a library post
tools.description: Return one library post by id. Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/library/posts/{id}.

tools.name: metricool_list_workflow_states
tools.title: List workflow states
tools.description: List the brand's library workflow states (for example Draft, In review, Approved). Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/library/states.

tools.name: metricool_get_best_times
tools.title: Get best times to publish
tools.description: Return the best times to publish for one network in a date range. Networks: facebook, instagram, tiktok, linkedin, youtube. Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/besttimes/{provider}.

tools.name: metricool_get_brand_summary
tools.title: Get post performance summary
tools.description: Return the brand's published-post metrics for a date range (all networks), optionally filtered by brand tag ids. Swagger: GET /v2/analytics/brand-summary/posts.

from.description: Start date (the vendor parameter has no declared format; use yyyy-mm-dd).

to.description: End date (the vendor parameter has no declared format; use yyyy-mm-dd).

tags.description: Brand tag ids; keeps only items that have any of them.

tools.name: metricool_get_metric_total
tools.title: Get one aggregated metric
tools.description: Return one engagement metric for one network, aggregated over a date range (for example a total of impressions). Swagger: GET /v2/analytics/aggregation.

network.description: Network name, for example instagram or facebook.

metric.description: Metric name as the Metricool analytics API defines it, for example impressions.

from.description: Start date (the vendor parameter has no declared format; use yyyy-mm-dd).

to.description: End date (the vendor parameter has no declared format; use yyyy-mm-dd).

subject.description: Optional vendor subject filter, as the API defines it.

scope.description: Optional vendor scope filter, as the API defines it.
